current_session: SELECT * FROM arp_agent_sessions WHERE agent_id=:agent_id AND state!='PURGED';
request_exact: SELECT * FROM arp_context_requests WHERE turn_id=:turn_id AND provider_request_ordinal=:ordinal;
indexed_all_old_groups: SELECT c.*,g.seq_from,g.seq_to FROM session_chunks c JOIN indexed_groups g USING(group_id) WHERE g.seq_to<:recent_start AND c.rowid>:after_rowid ORDER BY c.rowid LIMIT :page_size;
vector_page: SELECT v.*,g.seq_from,g.seq_to,c.rowid FROM session_vectors v JOIN session_chunks c USING(chunk_id) JOIN indexed_groups g USING(group_id) WHERE v.embedding_fingerprint=:embedding AND g.seq_to<:recent_start AND c.rowid>:after_rowid ORDER BY c.rowid LIMIT :page_size;
fts_words: SELECT c.chunk_id,bm25(session_words) AS rank FROM session_words JOIN session_chunks c ON c.rowid=session_words.rowid JOIN indexed_groups g USING(group_id) WHERE session_words MATCH :escaped_match AND g.seq_to<:recent_start ORDER BY rank,c.chunk_id LIMIT :limit;
claim_job: UPDATE arp_jobs SET state='LEASED',owner_id=:owner,lease_until_ms=:lease,row_version=row_version+1,attempts=attempts+1 WHERE job_id=:job AND state='PENDING' AND row_version=:version AND next_at_ms<=:now AND deadline_ms>:now;
begin_drain: UPDATE arp_agent_sessions SET state='DRAINING',generation=generation+1,row_version=row_version+1,destroy_command_id=:command,destroy_command_hash=:hash,updated_at_ms=:now WHERE session_id=:session AND state IN ('CREATING','ACTIVE','QUARANTINED') AND row_version=:version;
begin_purge: UPDATE arp_agent_sessions SET state='PURGING',row_version=row_version+1,sealed_highwater=:highwater,delete_proof_ref_json=:proof,updated_at_ms=:now WHERE session_id=:session AND state='DRAINING' AND row_version=:version;
finish_purge: UPDATE arp_agent_sessions SET state='PURGED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at_ms=:now WHERE session_id=:session AND state='PURGING' AND row_version=:version;
pending_blob_roots: SELECT * FROM arp_blob_roots WHERE session_id=:session AND state='LIVE';
catalogue_exact: SELECT r.*,a.state,a.row_version,a.scope_ref_json FROM arp_catalog_revisions r JOIN arp_catalog_activation a USING(entry_kind,entry_id,revision,content_hash) WHERE r.entry_kind=:kind AND r.entry_id=:id AND r.revision=:rev AND r.content_hash=:hash;
skill_use_exact: SELECT * FROM arp_skill_uses WHERE session_id=:session AND use_key=:key;
read_effective_context_policy: SELECT * FROM arp_context_policy_adoptions WHERE session_id=:session_id ORDER BY adoption_revision DESC LIMIT 1;
